name: Painter choice
responsibility: Chooses the painter of a canvas once, from what the browser says: Vello on WebGPU with a real adapter, Vello GPU on WebGL2 with a hardware context, Vello on the CPU otherwise
description: A software WebGPU adapter, or none, sends the canvas to WebGL2. WebGL2 refuses a context with a major performance caveat and a renderer whose name says it draws in software, and the rule reads no frame back. A WebGPU painter that fails at work gets one more try, and a second failure soon after sends the canvas to WebGL2. A WebGL2 painter that fails or loses its context gives way to the CPU painter. Each new painter takes a fresh canvas, because a canvas that held a GPU context never takes a 2D one. The caller shows which painter draws, and why WebGPU and WebGL2 do not.

outgoing.label: start the WebGPU, WebGL2 or CPU painter
